name: National
description: Latest news, policies, and developments in India

headlines.title: National Education Policy 2023 Implementation
headlines.summary: Ministry of Education rolls out NEP 2023 with new curriculum framework
headlines.content: The National Education Policy 2023 implementation has entered Phase 2. Key highlights include integration of vocational training with academics, multilingual education options, and skill-based learning modules. This affects all school boards and higher educational institutions across India.

headlines.title: India's Monsoon Forecast for 2024
headlines.summary: IMD predicts normal monsoon with 102% of long-period average rainfall
headlines.content: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has predicted a normal monsoon season for 2024 with approximately 102% of the long-period average (LPA) rainfall expected. This is crucial for agriculture and water resources management across the country.

Union Budget 2024 allocates Rs. 2.14 lakh crore for capital expenditure
India's manufacturing sector contributes 17.3% to GDP
New Parliament Building inaugurated on September 18, 2023

mcqs.question: Who is the current Chief Election Commissioner of India?
mcqs.explanation: Rajiv Kumar is the current Chief Election Commissioner of India, appointed in October 2022.

mcqs.question: In which year was the National Disaster Management Act enacted?
mcqs.explanation: The Disaster Management Act was enacted in 2005 and provides a comprehensive mechanism for disaster management in the country.

name: International
description: Global news, international relations, and world events

headlines.title: Global Economic Growth Slowdown
headlines.summary: IMF revises global growth forecast amid geopolitical tensions
headlines.content: The International Monetary Fund has revised its global growth forecast downward to 3.2% for 2024, citing ongoing geopolitical tensions, inflation concerns, and trade uncertainties as major factors.

headlines.title: UN Climate Summit Agreements
headlines.summary: Nations commit to new climate action targets for 2025-2030
headlines.content: At the latest UN climate summit, 195 countries agreed on enhanced climate commitments. The agreement focuses on reducing carbon emissions by 45% by 2030 and transitioning to renewable energy sources.

quickFacts: USA remains the world's largest economy with GDP of $27.4 trillion
China's economy grew at 5.3% in 2023
EU approved €50 billion recovery package for Eastern Europe
BRICS expands with new member countries joining the bloc

mcqs.question: Which country recently became the largest economy by GDP (as of 2024)?
mcqs.explanation: The United States remains the world's largest economy with a nominal GDP exceeding $27 trillion.

mcqs.question: Who is the current UN Secretary-General?
mcqs.explanation: António Guterres has been serving as the UN Secretary-General since January 2017.

name: Economy
description: Economic indicators, markets, and financial news

headlines.title: RBI Maintains Repo Rate at 6.5%
headlines.summary: Reserve Bank keeps benchmark rate unchanged to manage inflation
headlines.content: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee has decided to maintain the repo rate at 6.5%, citing inflation concerns and economic stability. The decision was expected by market analysts.

headlines.title: Stock Markets Hit New Highs
headlines.summary: Sensex and Nifty reach record levels on strong corporate earnings
headlines.content: Indian stock markets have reached new all-time highs with the Sensex crossing 75,000 and Nifty 50 surpassing 22,500 marks, driven by strong Q4 earnings and positive FPI inflows.

quickFacts: India's inflation rate stands at 4.2% (WPI basis)
Foreign Direct Investment in FY 2024 reached $85.1 billion
Rupee strengthened to 82.5 against US Dollar
National Stock Exchange is the world's largest exchange by trading volume

mcqs.question: What is the current RBI Repo Rate (as of May 2024)?
mcqs.explanation: The RBI maintains the repo rate at 6.5% to balance inflation control and economic growth.

mcqs.question: Which ministry is responsible for Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) policies in India?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Commerce & Industry handles FDI policies and foreign investment promotion in India.

headlines.title: India's Chandrayaan-3 Success
headlines.summary: ISRO's lunar lander completes successful mission operations
headlines.content: Chandrayaan-3 has completed its mission objectives with successful deployment of scientific instruments on the lunar surface. This marks a significant achievement in India's space exploration program.

headlines.title: Breakthrough in Quantum Computing
headlines.summary: New quantum processor achieves error correction milestone
headlines.content: Researchers have developed a quantum processor with significantly improved error correction capabilities, moving closer to practical quantum computing applications.

India ranks 4th in global AI research publications

mcqs.question: Which Indian space mission successfully landed on the Moon's South Pole?
mcqs.explanation: Chandrayaan-3 successfully demonstrated soft landing and payload deployment on the lunar surface.

mcqs.question: What does ISRO stand for?
mcqs.explanation: ISRO stands for Indian Space Research Organization, the national space agency of India.

name: Sports

headlines.title: India Wins ICC T20 World Cup 2024
headlines.summary: Team India defeats Australia in thrilling final
headlines.content: India's cricket team won the ICC T20 World Cup 2024 after defeating Australia in the final. Virat Kohli's outstanding century played a crucial role in the victory.

headlines.title: Paris Olympics 2024 Preparations
headlines.summary: Indian athletes complete final training for upcoming games
headlines.content: With just months to go, Indian athletes across various sports are intensifying their training for the Paris Olympics 2024, aiming to exceed the Tokyo 2020 medal tally.

Badminton is India's fastest growing Olympic sport

mcqs.question: Who is the captain of the Indian cricket team (as of 2024)?
mcqs.explanation: Rohit Sharma is the captain of the Indian cricket team across all formats.

mcqs.question: In which sport did Neeraj Chopra win India's first Olympic gold (2021)?
mcqs.explanation: Neeraj Chopra won India's first individual Olympic gold medal in javelin throw at Tokyo 2021.

name: Awards

headlines.title: Padma Awards 2024 Announced
headlines.summary: President honors 121 individuals with Padma Awards
headlines.content: The President of India has announced 121 Padma Awards including 16 Padma Vibhushan, 93 Padma Bhushan, and 12 Padma Shri awards to recognize exceptional contributions in various fields.

headlines.title: Bharat Ratna 2024 Bestowed
headlines.summary: Three distinguished individuals receive India's highest civilian award
headlines.content: The President has conferred the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor, to three deserving individuals for their extraordinary contributions to national development.

quickFacts: Padma Vibhushan is the 2nd highest civilian award
Bharat Ratna recipients are announced on Republic Day
Ashoka Chakra is awarded for bravery in wartime
Kirti Chakra is awarded for bravery in peacetime

mcqs.question: Which is India's highest civilian award?
mcqs.explanation: Bharat Ratna is India's highest civilian honor awarded for exceptional service to the nation.

mcqs.question: On which date are Padma Awards announced annually?
mcqs.explanation: Padma Awards are traditionally announced on Republic Day, January 26.

name: Government Schemes
description: Government programs, schemes, and policy updates

headlines.title: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi Extended
headlines.summary: Scheme now covers additional categories of farmers
headlines.content: The government has extended PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi to include marginal landholders and tenant farmers, ensuring more farmers benefit from the Rs. 6,000 annual support.

headlines.title: Ayushman Bharat Coverage Expands
headlines.summary: Healthcare scheme reaches 50 million additional beneficiaries
headlines.content: The Ayushman Bharat scheme has been expanded to provide health coverage to 50 million additional families, strengthening the healthcare delivery system across rural and semi-urban areas.

quickFacts: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana has 500+ million beneficiaries
Ujwala scheme has distributed 100+ million LPG connections
Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana has trained 15 million youth
Start-up India scheme has supported 100,000+ startups

mcqs.question: How much annual financial support does PM-Kisan provide to farmers?
mcqs.explanation: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi provides Rs. 6,000 per year in three installments to eligible farmers.

mcqs.question: What is the maximum coverage amount under Ayushman Bharat?
mcqs.explanation: Ayushman Bharat provides health coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for hospitalization.
